syllabus_topics: Basis of chemical kinetics and chemical equilibrium
Kinetics of homogeneous and heterogeneous reactions
Basic types of reactors, batch and continuous systems
Piston-flow reactors, ideally mixed batch and continuous reactors
Reactor cascades and non-ideally mixed systems
Choice of reactor type and optimization with respect to maximum production
Bioreactors, basic terms and basic technological scheme of the process
Bioreactor types, kinetics of biochemical processes, limitation of microorganism growth
Configurations of supply and distribution of components limiting the microorganism growth
Calculations and design of basic bioreactor types, influence of hydrodynamics and other factors on production
Fundamentals of technical design for reactors and bioreactors from laboratory to industrial scale
Material for reactors and bioreactors, hygienic design, technological design
Sealing of reactors, oscillation of movable structures, natural frequencies
bibliography: Richardson J. F., Peacock D. G.: Coulson & Richardson's Chemical Engineering, Volume 3: Chemical & Biochemical Reactors & Process Control, 3rd Edition, 1994.
Nauman E. B.: Chemical Reactor Design, Optimization, and Scaleup, McGraw Hill, 2002
Aiba S., Humphrey A. E., Millis N. F.: Biochemical Engineering. New York Academic Press, 2nd edition, 1973.
Moss D.: Pressure vessel design manual. Gulf Professional Publishing, 2004.
